title: The Dance Step Taught Slowly
youtube_title: The Dance Step Taught Slowly | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Lior is just outside the fun, close to a dance step taught at the speed of the newest feet. Tamsin changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Lior has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
